_comment: TECH v0.9.3 E8 visible map states of $1A2 (QA placeholders, D-14; vanilla Magitek-lab tiles). The map startup event EvOuterInit (events/celes_enablers_v092) writes these BG1 tiles with event cmd $73 from the persistent D-21 bits. The builder (patches/celes_enablers_v092.py map_states()) asserts that every set_tiles line of EvOuterMem* / EvOuterArc* equals this file, that the 'none' memorial state equals the compiled layout, that every state differs from the others of its region, and that every memorial x archive combination leaves the reachable floor identical to the base map (no wall made walkable, no trigger cut off). v0.9.2 changed only one row with wall-edge tiles that read as part of the wall (user runtime V4).

memorial.role: memorial wall above the memorial trigger (wall face row 10 + lower wall row 11)

archive.role: archive doorway above the archive trigger (wall face row 10 + lower wall row 11)

none.look: plain machinery wall: no memorial (same tiles as the layout)

tags.look: temporary memorial: lit panel of hanging name tags / plaques (light vertical tag strips)

stone.look: permanent memorial: four light stone pillars on a heavy riveted base, 4 x 2 tiles, replaces the tags (all impassable tiles)

sealed.look: sealed archive: closed framed grate door

kept.look: retained archive (Preserve): open doorway with intact record shelves (light horizontal bars)

burned.look: burned archive (Burn): black burned-out opening above rubble
